description_sq:
Shesim dyqan perball Pediatrise.
Dyqani pozicionohet buze rruges kryesore, ne katin zero me fasade dhe akses te menjehershem.
Ka nje siperfaqe prej 28m2 dhe organizohet ne openspace dhe nje tualet.
Dyqani eshte i pershtatshem per tipologji te ndyshme biznesi.
Disponon dokumentacion te rregullt hipotekor.
Dyqani eshte mundesi e mire investimi pasi momentalisht eshte e dhene me qera .
Per nje vizite ne prone, me kontaktoni
description_en: We are selling a shop in front of the Pediatrician. The shop is positioned on the edge of the main road, on the ground floor with a facade and immediate access. It has a surface of 28m2 and is organized in open space and a toilet. The store is suitable for different types of business. Has regular mortgage documentation. The shop is a good investment opportunity as it is currently rented. For a visit to the property, contact me
